page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual server powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. Built on x86_64 architecture using KVM hypervisor technology, the instance features 8 vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with 2 threads per core, 40 MB L3 cache, and 32 GB of RAM. Compute acceleration is provided by a dedicated NVIDIA Pascal P4 GPU equipped with 8 GB of VRAM. The instance includes a 2 Gbps baseline network capacity, zero bundled local storage, and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results reflect legacy CPU performance characteristics alongside modest memory throughput. The single-core stress-ng performance score of 953.38 falls into the bottom 10 percent of recorded benchmarks, while the multi-core stress-ng result of 4755.08 ranks in the bottom 25 percent. PassMark evaluation shows a middle-tier CPU score of 6698.53, alongside lower marks in extended instructions (4265.68), database operations (2252.2), and encryption tasks (2024.54). Uncached memory read bandwidth reaches 37.18 GB/sec and write bandwidth reaches 25.34 GB/sec. Static web throughput is recorded at 6.06 GB/sec with Redis SET performance at 5.48 million operations per second.

The inclusion of an NVIDIA P4 GPU provides specialized hardware acceleration for lightweight AI inference, media encoding, and computer vision tasks. However, the older Intel Broadwell CPU architecture and lower memory bandwidth present performance bottlenecks for compute-heavy host processes or memory-bound data pipelines. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the hardware profile offers entry-level GPU resources paired with standard vCPU-to-memory ratios without requiring high-end accelerator investments. The instance is suitable for small-scale GPU inference, legacy video processing, and general-purpose GPU application development requiring network-attached storage.
